queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), first_cut AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ra.avg_length > oa.avg_length), first_cut_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM first_cut) SELECT AVG(fc.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_length, AVG(fc.avg_length - oa.avg_length) AS mean_above_overall_average, AVG(fc.avg_length - fcm.avg_length) AS mean_above_first_cut_mean FROM first_cut fc CROSS JOIN overall_average oa CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fcm WHERE fc.avg_length > fcm.avg_length;
